verdict.rationale: Sierra's Live Assist puts a human rep in front of the customer while the AI guides next steps in chat or calls. That is a copilot-style supervised deployment, but the evidence never says the agent drafts replies that a human approves before sending. The 'merge approval workflows' cover releasing changes to the agent, not approving individual customer messages, so they don't count toward this story. Missing for 10: an explicit draft-and-approve mode for customer replies, documentation of an approval queue or workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
